Plain Language Summary for New Source Review (NSR) Renewal Certification 
Application for Air New Source Review Permit Number 131651 
 
The following summary is provided for this pending air permit application being reviewed by the Texas 
Commission on Environmental Quality as required by 30 Texas Administrative Code Chapter 39. The 
information provided in this summary may change during the technical review of the application and are not 
federal enforceable representations of the permit application. 
Aligned Data Centers REIT LLC (Aligned) (CN606478972) has submitted an application for renewal of permit 
number 131651. The ADC Plano (RN102319506) is a data center at 2800 Summit Avenue, Plano, Texas, 
Collin County. 
This renewal application will authorize the continued operation of twenty (20) diesel engine generators and five 
(5) diesel tanks. Aligned has certified there will be no changes to the permit. The following permitted emission 
rates will remain the same. 
 
 
Pollutant Permitted Emissions (tons per year) Emissions Added/Removed (tons per year) Total Proposed Emissions (tons per year) 
NOx 0.48 0.00 0.48 
CO 0.06 0.00 0.06 
VOC 0.02 0.00 0.02 
PM 0.01 0.00 0.01 
PM10 0.01 0.00 0.01 
PM2.5 0.01 0.00 0.01 
SO2 < 0.01 0.00 < 0.01 
NH3 < 0.01 0.00 < 0.01 
 
The facilities being renewed continue to be controlled by best management practices.
